notes.title: ver.1.030 Version Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed some translation errors.
2. Fixed an issue where after sleeping on Day 24 of the Righteous route, the story would return to the Neutral route.
3. Fixed the effect of the "Causality" skill obtained from capturing the Fortune Teller.
4. Added "Slime" and "Dissolving Liquid"
which may drop after triggering traps or defeating specific enemies.

Please press F10 to report any bugs.

notes.title: ver.1.027 Version Update
notes.notes:
1. Added voice lines for all endings  
2. Added resolution options up to 3840x2160  
3. Fixed some errors in character portraits and expressions  
4. Fixed a bug where stealing from Cinders could give double rewards  

Please press F10 to report any bugs.

notes.title: ver.1.023 Version Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed some text and translation errors  
2. Fixed an issue where music would sometimes overlap  
3. Attempted to improve performance issues in the late game

Please press F10 to report any problems.

notes.title: ver.1.018 Version Update
notes.notes:
1. Added new voice clips
2. Correctly tracks protagonist-related stats

If you encounter any bugs, please press F10 to report them.

notes.title: ver.1.016 Version Update
notes.notes:
1.Fixed an issue where the alley quest could cause script and save data crashes
2.Fixed missing sound effects in some CG scenes

If you encounter any bugs, please press F10 to report them.

notes.title: ver.1.015 Version Update
notes.notes:
1.Added unlock condition hints for CGs
2.You can now preview each CG and Live2D on the CG collection page
3.Fixed an issue where some character sprites disappeared in custom battles

If you encounter any bugs, please press F10 to report them.

notes.title: 1.008 Version update
notes.notes:
1. Confirm that all CG can be unlocked
2. Continue to track the black screen problem

Full CG unlock function will be added soon
Please press F10 to report any BUG

notes.title: 1.007 Version Update
notes.notes:
1.Issue where after Chapter 3 “Flower Spirit” boss fight, players cannot return to the main screen normally

2.Issue where a black screen appears after battle

3.Black screen issue when MaxAP +1 occurs
This fix is experimental. If after updating you still encounter the same or other issues, please press F10 in-game to report the problem so we can further analyze.

Please restart Steam to update the game.

notes.title: Version 1.005 – Stability Update
notes.notes:
1.Attempted to fix black screen after loading saves
2.Addressed abnormal issues occurring after battle ends
3.Rearranged CG unlock page layout

notes.title: "Falling with Ice Phoenix!" Steam Page Now Live!! - An Adult Version of the Classic Game "NS-SHAFT"?!
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/d5c37d081151a92602729d5fa2257db2bc21a451.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685500/_/?utm_source=steampost&utm_campaign=en1

Published by Eternal Alice Studio and developed by F Project, the vertical scrolling action game "Falling with Ice Phoenix!" now has a store page on Steam. Scheduled for release in November 2024, interested players can add it to their wishlist to stay updated!

"Retrieve the Lost Orb: A Stairway Adventure for Adults"

In a distant, otherworldly land, the protagonist Tavaro, piloting his aircraft, suddenly encounters a storm and crashes. The falling aircraft collides with the Crystal Palace at the top of the Sky Tower.

The Sky Tower, located at the center of the continent, is filled with monsters and traps, and the Crystal Palace is the central hub of the Sky Tower. Flovia, the lord of the Crystal Palace, is playing with the frost orb that controls the entire palace when the crash occurs. Due to the collision caused by Tavaro, Flovia accidentally drops the orb to the bottom of the tower, causing the monsters to lose control and rampage.

To help Flovia retrieve the lost orb, Tavaro uses his expertise to guide her in descending techniques, and the two set off together towards the lower levels. Facing trap-filled floors and malevolent monster lords, an adventure full of unknowns and challenges begins...

"Classic Gameplay with New Twists"

Inspired by the famous Japanese mini-game "NS-SHAFT", this vertical scrolling action game incorporates many new elements, including special mechanism floors, hovering techniques, boss attacks, and of course, the "action" elements beloved by old gentlemen!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/2299f4b6b3d4ea5b97999c9422dde29af4a12d45.png

"Unique Platform Mechanism Design"

"Exciting and Intense Boss Battles"

Each boss has unique designs and attack methods, with a dazzling array of attacks that will challenge the players' reaction skills!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/9a3728a1db752221d1949ba3531c7e4dbddde78a.png
